scope: operational dataset, paper/document, attribution, redistribution, and removal review for bounded science sources; not legal advice or a final ownership determination

pes2o_v3.material_gap: the pinned repository contains v3 shards marked v3-fos-license, while the pinned card calls v2 latest and documents no v3 construction or license-selection semantics
pes2o_v3.bounded_policy: admit only records whose v3 metadata reports CC0, CCBY, CCBYSA, pd, or public-domain; metadata filtering is engineering evidence, not legal acceptance
pes2o_v3.human_decision_required: obtain authoritative v3 documentation or written confirmation, validate per-paper metadata semantics, and approve attribution/removal scope

finepdfs_edu_en.material_gap: the shard schema exposes URL and extraction metadata but no per-document content license
finepdfs_edu_en.human_decision_required: accept Common Crawl and underlying-PDF rights risk, ODC attribution, and a non-redistribution or separately approved redistribution policy

common_pile_arxiv.dataset_release: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, and public-domain paper selection
common_pile_arxiv.paper_source: arXiv source files with per-record license metadata
common_pile_arxiv.material_gap: the project explicitly warns that license laundering or inaccurate metadata can cause incorrect assignment
common_pile_arxiv.human_decision_required: approve the accepted license set, attribution/share-alike delivery, metadata-reliability risk, and correction/removal process

common_pile_pubmed.dataset_release: CC BY, CC BY-SA, and CC0 article selection
common_pile_pubmed.paper_source: PubMed Central nXML with per-record license metadata
common_pile_pubmed.material_gap: the project gives the same license-laundering/inaccurate-metadata warning
common_pile_pubmed.human_decision_required: approve article-license metadata, attribution/share-alike delivery, correction/removal, and intended model/release scope

proof_pile_2_arxiv.material_gap: the card says underlying licenses are unchanged, but the bounded shard exposes arXiv ID and URL without per-paper license
proof_pile_2_arxiv.human_decision_required: obtain a reliable per-paper license mapping or reject this tokenizer supplement

non_conclusions: open access means public domain or permits every training, redistribution, or commercial scope
ODC-By database rights clear copyright in each paper or PDF
a URL, arXiv ID, PMC ID, or Semantic Scholar ID establishes permission
technical metadata filtering cures inaccurate or laundered license metadata
OCR, language, security, overlap, and contamination qualification grants training authority

acceptance_record_required.authority: named human with authority for the operating organization and intended use
must_record: accepted/rejected sources, document-license identifiers, and exact evidence hashes
FinePDFs/Common Crawl and underlying-PDF risk disposition
CC BY attribution and CC BY-SA handling for paper-derived data and outputs
Proof-Pile per-paper license mapping or rejection
research, publication, model-weight release, commercial, and corpus-redistribution scope
rights/removal contact, document/hash/URL deny-ledger owner, response and rebuild policy
date, name, and signature or equivalent auditable approval

decision: no science source is approved by this automated review; keep bounded successors blocked until the required human acceptance record exists
